triage_classes.action: Check whether the exact gate is already discharged by audited merged repo material; batch multiple compatible closures when safe.
Locate matching merged deep-closure/follow-up records and restart from their deepest FIRST_MISSING_LEMMA or SMALLEST_NEXT_PROOF_TARGET; do not redo the earlier literature sweep.
Attack the precise missing theorem or adapter directly. Use focused external search only when needed; use broad Work discovery only as fallback.

priority_order: Direct relevance to Stage27-19 or Stage27-20 current barriers
Merged prior deep-closure work already narrowed to a precise missing lemma
Reusable gates with multiple downstream receivers

known_merged_examples: PR #1188: SR-STR-015, SR-STR-019, SR-STR-021, SR-STR-024 deep closure
prior_work_rule.restart_contract: Use the deepest merged result as the baseline. Preserve corrections, firewalls, proved reductions, and exact missing-lemma names.

stage27_rule.stage27_19_target: Prefer gates that can improve or replace the current Stage27-19 fixed-R / moving-family / same-measure barrier chain.
stage27_rule.stage27_20_target: Prefer gates that can improve or replace the current Stage27-20 critical-wall same-MAIN-measure correlation/exceptional-mass barrier.

firewalls: EXTERNAL_GATE does not mean the perfect-cuboid existence/nonexistence problem is one lemma away.
A gate closes only on its exact receiver and hypotheses.
Do not promote a fixed-fiber, average-modulus, ambient-population, or different-measure result to a stronger physical receiver without an exact adapter.
Do not claim STRICT_SUBSQRT_POWER_SAVING_PROVED unless the Stage27 whole-family proof gate explicitly closes.
Do not claim perfect-cuboid existence or nonexistence from local gate closure.
